businessGoal: Allow users to navigate through multiple products effectively.

scenarios.goal: Verify pagination controls are displayed when there are more products than fit on one page.
Verify that clicking a page number updates the product grid to show products for that page.
Verify that the current page number is visually highlighted when navigating through pages.

outOfScope: Behavior of pagination controls when only one page of products is available.
Performance of pagination controls under high product volume.
clarifications: No information is provided about how to handle edge cases such as very few products or invalid page numbers.

manual.reason: The story involves visible UI behavior related to pagination controls and product listing.

api.reason: There is no mention of API interactions or endpoints related to pagination in the story.

ui.reason: The acceptance criteria include UI interactions that are visible to the user in the browser.
